from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityData(BaseModel):
    """Extracted metrics from a single document regarding university admission and graduation performance."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university as stated in the document")
    admission_rate: float | None = Field(description="First-year admission rate as a percentage (e.g., 30.2 for 30.2%)")
    graduation_rate: float | None = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate as a percentage (e.g., 84.0 for 84.0%)")
    cohort_year: str | None = Field(description="The specific cohort year associated with the graduation rate data (e.g., 'Fall 2015')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityData]
